notes: Full control-flow, call target, and literal-pool identity is established: base object pointer read once from Data_03001ea0, a redraw/rebuild loop rebuilds a 1..N-item icon row (Func_080a1038 + Func_080216e8 indexed through Data_080367dc) then draws a quantity readout via Func_080b0030, and A/cancel exit through a shared tail while Left(0x40)/Right(0x80) on ADDR_03001B04 adjust the u16 selection field at object+0x574 and loop. First respelling kept every field read inline via an M2C_FIELD(base, u16*, 0x574) macro on each use (mirroring the raw m2c draft literally); this produced a spurious `ldrsh r/reg-offset` load in place of the reference's `ldrh r,[r,#0]` immediate-offset load and left candidate 32 bytes over reference (472 vs 440, 185 wrong instructions). Widening the persisted selection value from a `u16 var_r8_51` local to `s32` (matching the sibling field_owner_54.c precedent, where the same 0x574 field is read into an `s32 selection` local rather than a narrow one) fixed that specific load and dropped the gap to 436 vs 440 / 150 wrong instructions -- the single largest, most concrete improvement found.

Remaining disagreement is register/stack-slot allocation, not control flow: the reference keeps the redraw loop count in `fp` and spills the create_pair return (Func_08021620's struct pointer, later reread for two field offsets and passed to Func_08016418) to a fifth stack slot at sp+16; every candidate tried instead keeps that pointer resident in `fp` and demotes the loop count to `r9`, never spilling a fifth stack word (candidate frame is `sub sp,#16` vs reference `sub sp,#20`). Reordering the two locals' C declarations relative to each other (count before the pointer, and back) produced an identical compiled score in both orders, so this is not a textual-declaration-order effect on this compiler route; it tracks some other liveness/cost input to gcc 2.96's local-alloc that a few respellings did not isolate.

This reads as a genuine compiler-internals residual on the last-mile register allocation, not a remaining source-shape gap in control flow or types -- a candidate for permuter-style bounded search (PERM_GENERAL on statement/expression order) rather than further manual respelling.
No external source, copied instruction bytes, inline assembly, fixed-register variable, compiler barrier, or compiler modification was used.
